_about: Elphinstone Dayrell's (1869-1917) collections of West African tales, gathered as a colonial district officer in Southern Nigeria and set down in his English: Folk Stories from Southern Nigeria (1910, introduction by Andrew Lang) and Ikom Folk Stories (1913).
